channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Kashmir Crime Branch Busts Major Export Fraud; Shagoo Couple Under Scanner for Duping Citizens
item.description: The Economic Offences Wing (EOW) of the Crime Branch Kashmir has filed a chargesheet against habitual offender Zahid Bashir Shagoo and his wife Shugufta in a high-value fraud case involving a forged export business to Dubai.

item.title: Ten dead as car rams into Christmas crowd in Guadeloupe; visuals surface
item.description: Radio Caraibes Internationale Guadeloupe reported that three of the injured were in serious condition. The incident occurred at Schoelcher Square, located opposite the town hall and the church, where preparations were underway.

item.title: Good news for travellers, Air India, Air India Express cap domestic fares amid IndiGo crisis
item.description: "Air India and; Air India Express clarify that, since 4 December, economy class airfares on non-stop domestic flights have been proactively capped to prevent the usual demand-and-supply mechanism being applied by revenue management systems," an Air India Spokesperson said.

item.title: Ranveer Singh's 'Dhurandhar 2' to clash with Yash's Toxic in March 2026; Dhurandhar part 1 drops on Netflix in Jan 2026
item.description: The makers of Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar announced the release date of part 2 in the film's end credits. On Day 2, Saturday, Ranveer Singh's film has earned over Rs 28 crore NBOC.

item.title: IndiGo crisis day 5: Company apologises to customers, says addressing refunds on priority
item.description: "We are addressing all customer refunds on priority. We are also working closely with all airports and partners to ensure timely updates are provided to customers at terminals, on our website, and via direct notifications," IndiGo shared in a statement.

item.title: Stars, Signals and Undeclared: The Real Story Behind Vladimir Putin's India Visit
item.description: On the surface, the visit delivered what the media expected: a renewed roadmap for bilateral trade, major agreements in energy and minerals, reaffirmation of defence-industrial cooperation, and a joint declaration to raise trade to USD 100 billion by 2030. In the age of polarising geopolitics, the India-Russia relationship had been ceremonially polished and publicly displayed.

item.title: Siddaramaiah Blames Centre for Karnataka's Rs 12,000 Crore GST Shortfall
item.description: Attacking Union Minister H.D. Kumarawamy for questioning his (Siddaramaiah) contributions to the Ahinda communities, the Chief Minister asked why Kumaraswamy is not questioning such things, as he is a Member of Parliament from Mandya.

item.title: Karnataka CM Siddaramaiah slams Kumaraswamy, calls him 'Manuvadi' over Bhagavad Gita in school curriculum proposal
item.description: Answering questions on the subject, the Chief Minister said that the former Karnataka Chief Minister had written to the Union Education Minister seeking inclusion of the Gita in the curriculum.

item.title: Home loan EMIs likely to fall after RBI slashes repo rate
item.description: Borrowers can expect their home loan interest rate to decline by 25 bps to about 7.1 per cent as several public sector banks, including Union Bank, Bank of India and Bank of Maharashtra, currently offer home loans at 7.35 per cent, according to multiple media reports.

item.title: JKAS Age Relaxation Crisis Deepens: Govt–Raj Bhavan Stand-Off Sparks Confusion Before Exam
item.description: Amid rising anxiety among aspirants, the LG Office rejects social media claims as "misleading," while the National Conference accuses Raj Bhavan of unnecessary delays over age relaxation.
